name: mnogovid-system-scanner
description: Consent-gated Linux host security assessment and network observation.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, run, and triage consent-gated Linux host checks.
interface.longDescription: A standalone MCP plugin that inventories Linux host security, runs allowlisted local scanners only after explicit consent, and records redacted evidence. It supports passive network observation and explicitly authorized port scans.
interface.defaultPrompt: Start Mnogovid System Scanner onboarding for this workspace: choose local or configured remote MCP target, check the system-scanner profile and toolchain, create a missing profile only after consent, then ask which analysis mode to run.
